_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Based on pterodactyl/game-eggs (MIT).
name: KissMP
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: The server for KISS Multiplayer, the BeamNG.drive multiplayer mod. Installs the KissMP release your players use, checked against GitHub's checksum.
startup: jq --argjson l "$([ "{{SHOW_IN_LIST}}" = 1 ] && echo true || echo false)" --arg m "{{MAP}}" '.show_in_server_list = $l | .map = $m | .upnp_enabled = false' config.json > config.json.new && mv -f config.json.new config.json; exec ./kissmp-server

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# KissMP. Downloads the KissMP server of the chosen release from its GitHub
# releases, checked against GitHub's checksum, for the node's CPU. The
# settings in config.json and the mods and addons folders are never touched.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
repo=TheHellBox/KISS-multiplayer
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
build=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
trap 'rm -rf "$build"' EXIT

want="${VERSION:-latest}"
tag=$(gh-release tag "$repo" "$want" 2>/dev/null) || tag=$(gh-release tag "$repo" "v$want" 2>/dev/null) ||
    fail "KissMP has no release $want. Set Version to latest, or to a release such as 0.8.0."
zip=$(gh-release assets "$repo" "$tag" | awk '$1 ~ /^KissMP.*\.zip$/ && !f { print $1; f = 1 }')
[ -n "$zip" ] || fail "KissMP $tag has no server download. Choose another version."
case "$(uname -m)" in
x86_64) dir=linux ;;
aarch64) dir=linux-arm ;;
*) fail "KissMP has no server for this CPU ($(uname -m))." ;;
esac

if [ -x kissmp-server ] && [ "$(cat .raptor-version 2>/dev/null)" = "$tag $dir" ]; then
    echo "KissMP $tag is already installed."
    exit 0
fi
rm -rf "$build" && mkdir -p "$build"
echo "Downloading KissMP $tag"
gh-release download "$repo" "$tag" "$zip" "$build/kissmp.zip" || fail "The download failed. Reinstall to try again."
unzip -q "$build/kissmp.zip" -d "$build/x"
bin=$(find "$build/x" -type f -name kissmp-server -path "*/$dir/*" | sed -n 1p)
[ -n "$bin" ] || fail "KissMP $tag has no server for this CPU in its download. Choose a newer version."
chmod +x "$bin"
mv -f "$bin" kissmp-server
mkdir -p mods addons

# The server's settings, which the server keeps as it is once it exists.
if [ ! -f config.json ]; then
    cat > config.json <<'JSON'
{
  "server_name": "A KissMP server",
  "description": "BeamNG.drive multiplayer",
  "map": "/levels/smallgrid/info.json",
  "max_players": 8,
  "tickrate": 60,
  "port": 3698,
  "max_vehicles_per_client": 3,
  "show_in_server_list": false,
  "upnp_enabled": false,
  "require_scripts": false
}
JSON
fi
echo "$tag $dir" > .raptor-version
echo "Installed KissMP $tag."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The KissMP release, such as 0.8.0, or latest for the newest: the same one your players have. Reinstall the server after changing it.

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: The name players see in the server list.

variables.name: Description
variables.description: The description players see in the server list.

variables.name: Map
variables.description: The map's info file, such as /levels/smallgrid/info.json or /levels/gridmap_v2/info.json or /levels/west_coast_usa/info.json.

variables.name: Max players
variables.description: How many players can join at once.

variables.name: Show in server list
variables.description: List the server in KissMP's public server list. Off, players join by address.
